name: chat
description: Realtime anonymous group chat built on a pnpm monorepo with React, Fastify, PostgreSQL, and self-hosted Centrifugo.
author: Ong Hin Journ <onghinjourn@gmail.com>

scripts.build: concurrently "pnpm --filter contracts run build" "pnpm --filter centrifugo run build"
scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter server run dev" "pnpm --filter frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: concurrently "pnpm --filter frontend lint" "pnpm --filter server lint" "pnpm --filter centrifugo lint" "pnpm --filter contracts lint"
